claim: Card Declined Issue While Renewing ChatGPT Plus Subscription
summary: I hope you're all doing well. I wanted to reach out to the community to discuss a frustrating issue I've been facing lately while trying to renew my ChatGPT Plus subscription. For the past week, I've been unable to renew my subscription due to my card getting declined. I'm using a Visa debit card, and this issue has been persisting regardless of the cards I've tried.
